description: This file defines a Java class `DroppedOutcome` implementing the `MappingOutcome` interface. It represents a specific outcome in a mapping process, specifically when a message is dropped. The class contains references to external messages and provides an `accept` method for visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: DroppedOutcome
classes.description: A final class representing a dropped message outcome, implementing the MappingOutcome interface.

methods.name: DroppedOutcome
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DroppedOutcome with a mapper ID and optionally a dropped message.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this outcome, handling exceptions and delegating to visitor methods.
